#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Finite-domain, probe-aware network rule miner.

Only the Python standard library is used.  Truth values on each partition are
held as Python integer bit sets; this makes the (small, bounded) clause search
both exhaustive and inexpensive without changing any of the eligibility rules.
"""

import json
import re
import sys
from fractions import Fraction


INPUT_LIMIT = 8_388_608
INT32_MIN = -(1 << 31)
INT32_MAX = (1 << 31) - 1
NUMERIC_TYPES = frozenset(("TIME", "SIZE", "COUNT"))
FIELD_TYPES = frozenset(("TIME", "SIZE", "COUNT", "ID", "FLAG"))
CMP_OPS = frozenset(("eq", "ne", "lt", "le", "gt", "ge"))

FIELD_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}\Z", re.ASCII)
ID_VALUE_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,32}\Z", re.ASCII)
TRACE_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,31}\Z", re.ASCII)


class JsonProblem(Exception):
    pass


class SchemaProblem(Exception):
    pass


class LargeInteger:
    """A valid JSON integer too large to be useful in any valid request."""

    __slots__ = ("text",)

    def __init__(self, text):
        self.text = text


class NonIntegerNumber:
    """A JSON number with a fraction/exponent (never an integer here)."""

    __slots__ = ("text",)

    def __init__(self, text):
        self.text = text


def parse_json_integer(text):
    # Avoid Python's integer-string digit limit and avoid constructing enormous
    # integers.  Every integer in the request grammar has a very small range.
    if len(text) - (1 if text.startswith("-") else 0) > 100:
        return LargeInteger(text)
    return int(text)


def no_duplicate_keys(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in result:
            raise JsonProblem("duplicate object key")
        result[key] = value
    return result


def reject_nonfinite(_text):
    raise JsonProblem("nonfinite number")


def check_container_depth(value):
    # Iterative so that deeply nested, otherwise valid JSON cannot hit the
    # Python recursion limit while we classify it as E_JSON.
    stack = [(value, 1)]
    while stack:
        item, depth = stack.pop()
        if type(item) is dict:
            if depth > 64:
                raise JsonProblem("container nesting exceeds 64")
            for child in item.values():
                if type(child) is dict or type(child) is list:
                    stack.append((child, depth + 1))
        elif type(item) is list:
            if depth > 64:
                raise JsonProblem("container nesting exceeds 64")
            for child in item:
                if type(child) is dict or type(child) is list:
                    stack.append((child, depth + 1))


def is_int(value):
    return type(value) is int


def require(condition):
    if not condition:
        raise SchemaProblem()


def exact_object(value, keys):
    require(type(value) is dict)
    require(set(value) == set(keys))


def valid_int32(value):
    return is_int(value) and INT32_MIN <= value <= INT32_MAX


def validate_request(request):
    exact_object(
        request,
        ("version", "schema", "window", "atoms", "policy", "train", "probes", "queries"),
    )
    require(request["version"] == 1 and is_int(request["version"]))
    k = request["window"]
    require(is_int(k) and 1 <= k <= 8)

    schema_input = request["schema"]
    require(type(schema_input) is list and 1 <= len(schema_input) <= 32)
    fields = []
    field_by_name = {}
    for definition in schema_input:
        require(type(definition) is dict)
        require("name" in definition and "type" in definition)
        name = definition["name"]
        field_type = definition["type"]
        require(type(name) is str and FIELD_NAME_RE.fullmatch(name) is not None)
        require(name not in field_by_name)
        require(type(field_type) is str and field_type in FIELD_TYPES)
        if field_type in NUMERIC_TYPES:
            exact_object(definition, ("name", "type", "min", "max"))
            lo = definition["min"]
            hi = definition["max"]
            require(valid_int32(lo) and valid_int32(hi) and lo <= hi)
            descriptor = (name, field_type, lo, hi)
        elif field_type == "ID":
            exact_object(definition, ("name", "type", "values"))
            values = definition["values"]
            require(type(values) is list and 1 <= len(values) <= 32)
            for item in values:
                require(type(item) is str and ID_VALUE_RE.fullmatch(item) is not None)
            require(len(set(values)) == len(values))
            descriptor = (name, field_type, frozenset(values))
        else:
            exact_object(definition, ("name", "type"))
            descriptor = (name, field_type)
        field_by_name[name] = (len(fields), descriptor)
        fields.append(descriptor)

    policy = request["policy"]
    exact_object(policy, ("max_width", "min_support", "min_witness"))
    max_width = policy["max_width"]
    min_support = policy["min_support"]
    min_witness = policy["min_witness"]
    require(is_int(max_width) and 1 <= max_width <= 4)
    require(is_int(min_support) and 1 <= min_support <= 4096)
    require(is_int(min_witness) and 1 <= min_witness <= 4096)

    atoms_input = request["atoms"]
    require(type(atoms_input) is list and len(atoms_input) <= 20)
    aggregate_ids = {}
    aggregate_defs = []
    compiled_atoms = []
    for atom in atoms_input:
        compiled_atoms.append(compile_atom(atom, k, field_by_name, aggregate_ids, aggregate_defs))

    # Validate and normalize every trace before evaluating any atom.
    all_trace_ids = set()
    total_traces = 0
    total_rows = 0
    normalized_partitions = {}
    training_sources = set()
    for partition_name in ("train", "probes", "queries"):
        traces_input = request[partition_name]
        require(type(traces_input) is list)
        total_traces += len(traces_input)
        require(total_traces <= 128)
        normalized_traces = []
        for trace in traces_input:
            exact_object(trace, ("id", "source", "rows"))
            trace_id = trace["id"]
            source = trace["source"]
            require(type(trace_id) is str and TRACE_NAME_RE.fullmatch(trace_id) is not None)
            require(type(source) is str and TRACE_NAME_RE.fullmatch(source) is not None)
            require(trace_id not in all_trace_ids)
            all_trace_ids.add(trace_id)
            if partition_name == "train":
                training_sources.add(source)
                require(len(training_sources) <= 16)
            rows_input = trace["rows"]
            require(type(rows_input) is list)
            total_rows += len(rows_input)
            require(total_rows <= 16384)
            rows = []
            times = set()
            for row in rows_input:
                exact_object(row, ("t", "values"))
                timestamp = row["t"]
                require(valid_int32(timestamp) and timestamp not in times)
                times.add(timestamp)
                values = row["values"]
                require(type(values) is list and len(values) == len(fields))
                for value, descriptor in zip(values, fields):
                    field_type = descriptor[1]
                    if field_type in NUMERIC_TYPES:
                        require(is_int(value) and descriptor[2] <= value <= descriptor[3])
                    elif field_type == "ID":
                        require(type(value) is str and value in descriptor[2])
                    else:
                        require(type(value) is bool)
                rows.append((timestamp, values))
            rows.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
            normalized_traces.append((trace_id, source, rows))
        normalized_partitions[partition_name] = normalized_traces

    contexts = {}
    context_limits = {"train": 4096, "probes": 128, "queries": 1024}
    query_metadata = []
    for partition_name in ("train", "probes", "queries"):
        partition_contexts = []
        for trace_id, source, rows in normalized_partitions[partition_name]:
            # Rows are already time-sorted, hence so are ending times.
            for start in range(0, len(rows) - k + 1):
                partition_contexts.append((rows, start, source))
                if partition_name == "queries":
                    query_metadata.append((trace_id, rows[start + k - 1][0]))
        require(len(partition_contexts) <= context_limits[partition_name])
        contexts[partition_name] = partition_contexts

    return {
        "k": k,
        "fields": fields,
        "atoms": compiled_atoms,
        "aggregate_defs": aggregate_defs,
        "max_width": max_width,
        "min_support": min_support,
        "min_witness": min_witness,
        "training_sources": sorted(training_sources),
        "contexts": contexts,
        "query_metadata": query_metadata,
    }


# Compiled term tags.  Tuples keep evaluation compact and avoid constructing
# any AST objects while processing contexts.
TERM_FIELD = 0
TERM_CONST = 1
TERM_SCALE = 2
TERM_ADD = 3
TERM_AGGREGATE = 4


def compile_term(term, k, field_by_name, inside_quantifier, aggregate_ids, aggregate_defs, depth=1):
    require(type(term) is dict)
    require(depth <= 4)
    keys = set(term)

    if keys == {"field", "at"}:
        name = term["field"]
        at = term["at"]
        require(type(name) is str and name in field_by_name)
        if at == "$" and type(at) is str:
            require(inside_quantifier)
            offset = -1
        else:
            require(is_int(at) and 0 <= at < k)
            offset = at
        field_index, descriptor = field_by_name[name]
        return (TERM_FIELD, field_index, offset), descriptor[1], 1

    if keys == {"const", "type"}:
        value = term["const"]
        value_type = term["type"]
        require(type(value_type) is str and value_type in FIELD_TYPES)
        if value_type in NUMERIC_TYPES:
            require(valid_int32(value))
        elif value_type == "ID":
            require(type(value) is str and ID_VALUE_RE.fullmatch(value) is not None)
        else:
            require(type(value) is bool)
        return (TERM_CONST, value), value_type, 1

    if keys == {"scale", "term"}:
        factor = term["scale"]
        require(is_int(factor) and -1024 <= factor <= 1024)
        child, child_type, nodes = compile_term(
            term["term"], k, field_by_name, inside_quantifier,
            aggregate_ids, aggregate_defs, depth + 1,
        )
        require(child_type in NUMERIC_TYPES)
        return (TERM_SCALE, factor, child), child_type, nodes + 1

    if keys == {"add"}:
        terms = term["add"]
        require(type(terms) is list and len(terms) == 2)
        left, left_type, left_nodes = compile_term(
            terms[0], k, field_by_name, inside_quantifier,
            aggregate_ids, aggregate_defs, depth + 1,
        )
        right, right_type, right_nodes = compile_term(
            terms[1], k, field_by_name, inside_quantifier,
            aggregate_ids, aggregate_defs, depth + 1,
        )
        require(left_type in NUMERIC_TYPES and left_type == right_type)
        return (TERM_ADD, left, right), left_type, left_nodes + right_nodes + 1

    if keys == {"aggregate", "field", "from", "to"}:
        operation = term["aggregate"]
        name = term["field"]
        start = term["from"]
        end = term["to"]
        require(type(operation) is str and operation in ("sum", "mean", "min", "max"))
        require(type(name) is str and name in field_by_name)
        require(is_int(start) and is_int(end) and 0 <= start <= end < k)
        field_index, descriptor = field_by_name[name]
        require(descriptor[1] in NUMERIC_TYPES)
        key = (operation, field_index, start, end)
        aggregate_id = aggregate_ids.get(key)
        if aggregate_id is None:
            aggregate_id = len(aggregate_defs)
            aggregate_ids[key] = aggregate_id
            aggregate_defs.append(key)
        return (TERM_AGGREGATE, aggregate_id), descriptor[1], 1

    raise SchemaProblem()


def compile_comparison(comparison, k, field_by_name, inside_quantifier, aggregate_ids, aggregate_defs):
    exact_object(comparison, ("cmp", "left", "right"))
    operation = comparison["cmp"]
    require(type(operation) is str and operation in CMP_OPS)
    left, left_type, left_nodes = compile_term(
        comparison["left"], k, field_by_name, inside_quantifier, aggregate_ids, aggregate_defs
    )
    right, right_type, right_nodes = compile_term(
        comparison["right"], k, field_by_name, inside_quantifier, aggregate_ids, aggregate_defs
    )
    require(left_nodes + right_nodes <= 64)
    require(left_type == right_type)
    if left_type not in NUMERIC_TYPES:
        require(operation in ("eq", "ne"))
    op_code = {"eq": 0, "ne": 1, "lt": 2, "le": 3, "gt": 4, "ge": 5}[operation]
    return (op_code, left, right)


def term_uses_dollar(term):
    tag = term[0]
    if tag == TERM_FIELD:
        return term[2] == -1
    if tag == TERM_SCALE:
        return term_uses_dollar(term[2])
    if tag == TERM_ADD:
        return term_uses_dollar(term[1]) or term_uses_dollar(term[2])
    return False


def compile_atom(atom, k, field_by_name, aggregate_ids, aggregate_defs):
    require(type(atom) is dict)
    if set(atom) == {"cmp", "left", "right"}:
        comparison = compile_comparison(
            atom, k, field_by_name, False, aggregate_ids, aggregate_defs
        )
        return (comparison, None)

    exact_object(atom, ("quantifier", "from", "to", "predicate"))
    quantifier = atom["quantifier"]
    start = atom["from"]
    end = atom["to"]
    require(type(quantifier) is str and quantifier in ("any", "all"))
    require(is_int(start) and is_int(end) and 0 <= start <= end < k)
    predicate = atom["predicate"]
    require(type(predicate) is dict and set(predicate) == {"cmp", "left", "right"})
    comparison = compile_comparison(
        predicate, k, field_by_name, True, aggregate_ids, aggregate_defs
    )
    uses_dollar = term_uses_dollar(comparison[1]) or term_uses_dollar(comparison[2])
    return (comparison, (quantifier == "all", start, end, uses_dollar))


MISSING = object()


def eval_term(term, rows, start, dollar, aggregate_cache, aggregate_defs):
    tag = term[0]
    if tag == TERM_FIELD:
        offset = dollar if term[2] == -1 else term[2]
        return rows[start + offset][1][term[1]]
    if tag == TERM_CONST:
        return term[1]
    if tag == TERM_SCALE:
        return term[1] * eval_term(term[2], rows, start, dollar, aggregate_cache, aggregate_defs)
    if tag == TERM_ADD:
        return (
            eval_term(term[1], rows, start, dollar, aggregate_cache, aggregate_defs)
            + eval_term(term[2], rows, start, dollar, aggregate_cache, aggregate_defs)
        )

    aggregate_id = term[1]
    value = aggregate_cache[aggregate_id]
    if value is not MISSING:
        return value
    operation, field_index, first, last = aggregate_defs[aggregate_id]
    values = [rows[start + offset][1][field_index] for offset in range(first, last + 1)]
    if operation == "sum":
        value = sum(values)
    elif operation == "mean":
        value = Fraction(sum(values), len(values))
    elif operation == "min":
        value = min(values)
    else:
        value = max(values)
    aggregate_cache[aggregate_id] = value
    return value


def eval_comparison(comparison, rows, start, dollar, aggregate_cache, aggregate_defs):
    left = eval_term(comparison[1], rows, start, dollar, aggregate_cache, aggregate_defs)
    right = eval_term(comparison[2], rows, start, dollar, aggregate_cache, aggregate_defs)
    operation = comparison[0]
    if operation == 0:
        return left == right
    if operation == 1:
        return left != right
    if operation == 2:
        return left < right
    if operation == 3:
        return left <= right
    if operation == 4:
        return left > right
    return left >= right


def eval_atom(atom, rows, start, aggregate_cache, aggregate_defs):
    comparison, quantifier = atom
    if quantifier is None:
        return eval_comparison(comparison, rows, start, 0, aggregate_cache, aggregate_defs)
    is_all, first, last, uses_dollar = quantifier
    if not uses_dollar:
        # Quantifier ranges are nonempty, so a body independent of "$" has the
        # same value for every binding.
        return eval_comparison(comparison, rows, start, 0, aggregate_cache, aggregate_defs)
    if is_all:
        for dollar in range(first, last + 1):
            if not eval_comparison(comparison, rows, start, dollar, aggregate_cache, aggregate_defs):
                return False
        return True
    for dollar in range(first, last + 1):
        if eval_comparison(comparison, rows, start, dollar, aggregate_cache, aggregate_defs):
            return True
    return False


def atom_truth_masks(atoms, contexts, aggregate_defs):
    masks = [0] * len(atoms)
    aggregate_count = len(aggregate_defs)
    for context_index, (rows, start, _source) in enumerate(contexts):
        bit = 1 << context_index
        aggregate_cache = [MISSING] * aggregate_count
        for atom_index, atom in enumerate(atoms):
            if eval_atom(atom, rows, start, aggregate_cache, aggregate_defs):
                masks[atom_index] |= bit
    return masks


def learn_and_answer(model):
    atoms = model["atoms"]
    train_contexts = model["contexts"]["train"]
    probe_contexts = model["contexts"]["probes"]
    query_contexts = model["contexts"]["queries"]
    query_metadata = model["query_metadata"]
    query_count = len(query_contexts)

    def empty_query_answers():
        return [
            {"trace": trace_id, "end": end, "must": 0, "may": 0, "status": "consistent"}
            for trace_id, end in query_metadata
        ]

    # Eligibility condition 1.  Validation, including all ASTs and all rows,
    # has already taken place before this shortcut.
    if not model["training_sources"] or not probe_contexts or not atoms:
        return {"version": 1, "classes": [], "queries": empty_query_answers()}

    aggregate_defs = model["aggregate_defs"]
    train_masks = atom_truth_masks(atoms, train_contexts, aggregate_defs)
    probe_masks = atom_truth_masks(atoms, probe_contexts, aggregate_defs)
    query_masks = atom_truth_masks(atoms, query_contexts, aggregate_defs) if query_count else [0] * len(atoms)

    train_count = len(train_contexts)
    probe_count = len(probe_contexts)
    train_full = (1 << train_count) - 1
    probe_full = (1 << probe_count) - 1
    query_full = (1 << query_count) - 1

    source_masks = []
    for source in model["training_sources"]:
        mask = 0
        for index, context in enumerate(train_contexts):
            if context[2] == source:
                mask |= 1 << index
        source_masks.append(mask)

    min_support = model["min_support"]
    min_witness = model["min_witness"]

    # allowed_signs[a] has bit 0 for a positive literal and bit 1 for a
    # negative literal.  A literal failing per-source support cannot occur in
    # any eligible clause, irrespective of the other literals.
    allowed_signs = []
    signed_train = []
    signed_probe = []
    signed_query = []
    for atom_index in range(len(atoms)):
        positive = train_masks[atom_index]
        negative = train_full ^ positive
        pair_train = (positive, negative)
        pair_probe = (probe_masks[atom_index], probe_full ^ probe_masks[atom_index])
        pair_query = (query_masks[atom_index], query_full ^ query_masks[atom_index])
        signed_train.append(pair_train)
        signed_probe.append(pair_probe)
        signed_query.append(pair_query)
        allowed = 0
        for sign in (0, 1):
            mask = pair_train[sign]
            if all((mask & source_mask).bit_count() >= min_support for source_mask in source_masks):
                allowed |= 1 << sign
        allowed_signs.append(allowed)

    # Dictionary value: [member count, representative literal tuple,
    #                    OR of member query vectors, AND of member query vectors]
    classes = {}
    max_width = model["max_width"]
    atom_count = len(atoms)

    def accept_clause(literals, clause_train, clause_probe):
        # The training OR must be full.  Essential witnesses are computed
        # independently for every literal and every source.
        if clause_train != train_full or clause_probe == probe_full:
            return
        width = len(literals)
        masks = [signed_train[atom_index][sign] for atom_index, sign in literals]
        for index in range(width):
            others = 0
            for other_index in range(width):
                if other_index != index:
                    others |= masks[other_index]
            essential = masks[index] & ~others
            for source_mask in source_masks:
                if (essential & source_mask).bit_count() < min_witness:
                    return

        query_vector = 0
        for atom_index, sign in literals:
            query_vector |= signed_query[atom_index][sign]
        representative = tuple(
            (atom_index, bool(sign)) for atom_index, sign in literals
        )
        entry = classes.get(clause_probe)
        if entry is None:
            classes[clause_probe] = [1, representative, query_vector, query_vector]
        else:
            entry[0] += 1
            entry[2] |= query_vector
            entry[3] &= query_vector

    # Enumerate each unordered atom-index subset once and each choice of one
    # polarity per selected atom once.  No semantic/dominance pruning occurs.
    def enumerate_from(next_atom, literals, clause_train, clause_probe):
        if literals:
            accept_clause(literals, clause_train, clause_probe)
            if len(literals) == max_width:
                return
        for atom_index in range(next_atom, atom_count):
            allowed = allowed_signs[atom_index]
            if not allowed:
                continue
            for sign in (0, 1):
                if not (allowed & (1 << sign)):
                    continue
                literals.append((atom_index, sign))
                enumerate_from(
                    atom_index + 1,
                    literals,
                    clause_train | signed_train[atom_index][sign],
                    clause_probe | signed_probe[atom_index][sign],
                )
                literals.pop()

    enumerate_from(0, [], 0, 0)

    signature_digits = (probe_count + 3) // 4
    class_items = list(classes.items())
    output_classes = []
    for signature, entry in class_items:
        representative = {
            "or": [
                {"atom": atom_index, "negated": negated}
                for atom_index, negated in entry[1]
            ]
        }
        output_classes.append({
            "signature": format(signature, "0%dx" % signature_digits),
            "members": entry[0],
            "representative": representative,
        })

    output_queries = []
    for query_index, (trace_id, end) in enumerate(query_metadata):
        bit = 1 << query_index
        must = 0
        may = 0
        for entry in classes.values():
            if not (entry[2] & bit):
                must += 1
            if not (entry[3] & bit):
                may += 1
        if must:
            status = "violating"
        elif may:
            status = "ambiguous"
        else:
            status = "consistent"
        output_queries.append({
            "trace": trace_id, "end": end, "must": must, "may": may, "status": status,
        })

    return {"version": 1, "classes": output_classes, "queries": output_queries}


def emit(value):
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def main():
    raw = sys.stdin.buffer.read(INPUT_LIMIT + 1)
    if len(raw) > INPUT_LIMIT:
        emit({"error": "E_LIMIT"})
        return
    try:
        if raw.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"):
            raise JsonProblem("BOM")
        text = raw.decode("utf-8", "strict")
        request = json.loads(
            text,
            object_pairs_hook=no_duplicate_keys,
            parse_int=parse_json_integer,
            parse_float=NonIntegerNumber,
            parse_constant=reject_nonfinite,
        )
        check_container_depth(request)
    except (JsonProblem, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, RecursionError, ValueError):
        emit({"error": "E_JSON"})
        return

    try:
        model = validate_request(request)
        response = learn_and_answer(model)
    except SchemaProblem:
        emit({"error": "E_SCHEMA"})
        return
    emit(response)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
